query:
SELECT
            id,
            account_id,
            account_type,
            amount,
            balance,
            timestamp,
            reason
        FROM budgeting.transactions
        WHERE
            ($1::UUID IS NULL OR account_id = $1::UUID)
            AND (
                $2::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL
                OR $3::UUID IS NULL
                OR (timestamp, id) < ($2, $3::UUID)
            )
            ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC
        LIMIT $4;
